questions.prompt: The page sends POST /api/session/delete, but no service marked a delete method as remote. What happens?
options: The gateway guesses the closest method
The request reaches the session service anyway
The server answers 404, because only listed remote methods can be called
questions.explanation: The gateway looks up namespace and method in its table of remote methods. A method nobody listed has no handler, so the request is refused.

questions.prompt: Why does the page call a generated stub instead of writing fetch calls by hand?
options: The stub comes from the list of remote methods, so names and argument shapes match the server
Fetch does not work in browsers
The stub runs the agent inside the browser
questions.explanation: The build writes one function per remote method from the server's own list, so a renamed method or a changed argument is caught at build time.

questions.prompt: A page opens the follow stream after the agent has run for 2 minutes. How does it get the earlier events?
options: It cannot; it sees only new events
The stream first sends the events already in the record, then new events and frames
questions.explanation: The record holds every committed event, so the follow stream starts with them and then continues with new events and live frames.
